name: memo_write
description: Write a concise task-local memo that remains available during this task and is returned to the host with the final result. Use for durable facts, decisions, constraints, and important discoveries; do not store transient chatter.

name: conversation_search
description: Search the append-only original conversation of this task, including older messages hidden from the current prompt by context compaction. Returns stable message_index references and snippets. Use this when an exact older detail may be missing from the summary.

name: conversation_read
description: Read an exact chunk of one message from the append-only original task conversation by the message_index returned from conversation_search. Increase char_offset to continue reading a long message.

name: task_complete
description: Complete the current task. Call this tool only when the task is fully finished. Put the final user-facing answer in output. Do not call this tool together with other tools.

name: plan_create
description: Optionally create the current task's first plan. Does not execute work. Use stable item IDs; status defaults to pending, arrays to [], status_note to ''. Completion is your assessment, not independent verification; link evidence when available.

reason.description: Why this change is needed, including any rework or invalidated result.

source_refs.description: Evidence: message:<index>, tool:<call_id>, memo:<id>, artifact:<id>, or external refs.

name: plan_read
description: Read the current plan (null before creation), or a retained historical revision.

name: plan_update
description: Patch existing item progress, description, evidence or status_note. Omitted fields are preserved; supplied arrays replace that field. Explain reopening completed work in reason. Use plan_revise for composition/dependency/approach changes. No action runs automatically.

expected_revision.description: The current revision read from the plan; stale changes are rejected.

reason.description: Why this change is needed, including any rework or invalidated result.

source_refs.description: Evidence: message:<index>, tool:<call_id>, memo:<id>, artifact:<id>, or external refs.

name: plan_revise
description: Replace the ordered item list, preserving omitted fields of retained IDs (including completed results). An item_id-only entry keeps that item unchanged. Absent IDs are excluded but remain in history. New/replacement work needs a new ID and description; excluded IDs cannot be reused. Explicitly reset status for rework and explain why. No tools run or files roll back.

expected_revision.description: The current revision read from the plan; stale changes are rejected.

reason.description: Why this change is needed, including any rework or invalidated result.

source_refs.description: Evidence: message:<index>, tool:<call_id>, memo:<id>, artifact:<id>, or external refs.

name: parent_ask
description: Ask your actual parent; immediately returns request_id. Use agent_wait_reply separately when needed. A positive reply does not grant additional tools. Optional related_request_id links a request known to you.

name: agent_reply
description: Answer a received question. Recipient is determined by the recorded request, never supplied here. This does not complete your task; continue your work after answering.

name: agent_wait_reply
description: Wait for one of your questions to be answered or closed. New requests/messages or Host control release the wait with a reason; handle them and wait again using the original request_id. Releasing this wait never cancels the request.

name: parent_notify
description: Send information to your actual parent, without expecting a reply or changing its instruction revision.

name: tool_request
description: Request a missing Host tool for this task, with its reason and intended use. Routes to your direct parent, or to Host at root. Requests and natural language replies grant no permission. Use tool_wait or tool_status to inspect actual application.

name: tool_forward
description: Forward a structured tool request received from a direct child to your parent, or submit it to Host at root. Keeps the original requesting task. Does not grant tools.

name: tool_wait
description: Wait for a known tool request decision. Incoming messages and Host control release this wait. Approved means queued: finish this tool batch before using the tool in the next decision. No automatic timeout or retry.

name: tool_status
description: Read this task's applied tool names/schema identity, revision, last offered revision and known structured requests. Only applied tools in the current schema are callable.
